slides.title: CAST = [[type badlo]]
points: **CAST(x AS type)** = value ka roop badlo
slides.note: Jaise rupaye ko dollar mein convert karna: value wahi, **format** naya 💱

slides.title: Text se [[number]]
slides.code:
SELECT
  CAST('123' AS INT) + 7
  AS result;
-- result: 130
slides.note: MySQL mein INT nahi chalta → **CAST('123' AS SIGNED)**

slides.title: Sort ko [[fix]] karo
slides.code:
SELECT roll_no, name
FROM students
ORDER BY
  CAST(roll_no AS INT);
slides.note: Aur best: column ka type hi **INT** rakho, roz CAST ka jhanjhat khatam 😎

slides.title: DB-wise [[shortcuts]]
slides.note: Ganda data ho to SQL Server ka TRY_CAST jaan bachata hai 🙌

slides.wrong:
roll_no TEXT column:
ORDER BY roll_no
→ 1, 10, 2, 9
slides.why: Number ko text mein rakha to sort **dictionary** jaisa hoga, ginti jaisa nahi 💀
